Global Horticulture Hub Launched in Andhra Pradesh

Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh laid the foundation for a global horticulture hub in Madanapalle, Andhra Pradesh. The project is valued at ₹1 lakh crore and is planned to span across 10 districts in the Rayalaseema region.
